title: Thai Summer Pilaf
description: A light and refreshing Thai-inspired pilaf dish perfect for summer, featuring a mix of summer ingredients and a blend of savoury and savory flavors.

ingredients.name: leaves
ingredients.notes: such as mint or Thai basil

ingredients.name: savory
ingredients.notes: such as chopped peanuts or fried shallots

ingredients.name: gzesty
ingredients.notes: such as grated ginger or lime zest

instructions: Heat the savory oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add the summer leaves and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Add the leaves and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Add the savory pilaf and stir to combine.
Add the savory and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the gzesty on top and serve hot.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional summer leaves if desired.
